description: This file implements the IpcLoop class, which manages an IPC communication loop using a dedicated thread, handling message processing, connection management, and RPC controller creation within the rialto server manager IPC namespace.

classes.name: IpcLoop
classes.description: Manages an IPC communication loop with threading, message processing, and connection handling.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to create an IpcLoop instance, establishing IPC channel and verifying version.

methods.name: IpcLoop
methods.description: Constructor initializing IPC channel, client, and starting the IPC thread.

methods.name: ~IpcLoop
methods.description: Destructor that disconnects the IPC channel, joins the thread, and cleans up resources.

methods.name: ipcThread
methods.description: Thread function that runs the IPC event loop, processing messages until shutdown.

methods.name: channel
methods.description: Returns the underlying IPC channel object.

methods.name: createBlockingClosure
methods.description: Creates a blocking closure object, choosing polling or semaphore based on thread context.

methods.name: createRpcController
methods.description: Creates and returns a new RPC controller for sending requests.
